newsitem.title: PERU: Rebel attack sparks Peru store fire, two hurt.
newsitem.headline: Rebel attack sparks Peru store fire, two hurt.

text.p: Suspected Marxist rebels burst into a textile store in Lima on Saturday, setting off grenades and sparking a large fire that injured at least two firefighters, police said.
"It's a terrorist attack. They used hand grenades," police bomb squad officer Carlos Samaniego told Reuters.
Peruvian anti-terrorist police confirmed the attack in Lima's working class La Victoria district was carried out by rebels of the Tupac Amaru Revolutionary Movement (MRTA).
About 20 MRTA members are holding 72 hostages at the Japanese ambassador's home in Lima in a siege which has lasted 88 days.
